parameters.content:
## Multi-Agent Council
**Master** = Claude A (plans + combines, failover Claude B).
**Workers** = research → Gemini A · quick → Gemini B · code → ChatGPT A · writing → ChatGPT B · analysis → Claude B.
**Reviewer** = Claude B.

Inputs: Telegram (polled every 5 s, no public URL needed) and the localhost page (webhook).
Outputs: Telegram reply + localhost feed.

All keys, models and role routing come from environment variables (.env) — nothing secret lives in this workflow.
Activate the workflow (toggle top-right) so the triggers run.

nodes.name: Poll Telegram
nodes.notes: Telegram getUpdates polling. Emits one item per authorised message.

nodes.name: Master: Plan
nodes.notes: Claude A decides: answer directly, or design the worker workflow (roles + tasks).

nodes.name: Workers: Execute
nodes.notes: Runs all planned tasks in parallel. Each role has a failover chain across the 6 agents.

nodes.name: Master: Combine
nodes.notes: Claude A merges worker results into one answer.

nodes.name: Reviewer: QA
nodes.notes: Claude B checks the draft. Disable with REVIEW_ENABLED=false.

nodes.name: Deliver: Telegram + Localhost
nodes.notes: Sends the reply to Telegram and publishes to the localhost feed.
